summary: A rigid box lorry: a day cab over a 5.5 m dry-freight box with a roller shutter, on an 8 m chassis. joints cab_tilt, door_l, door_r; options body, paint; sockets socket_driver, socket_tow, seat_driver, seat_pax_1 …; drivable (vehicles).
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.box_truck or place "prefab": "box_truck" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d(), vehicles().
Drive it from a behavior: e.get(Vehicle).drive(throttle=..., steer=...).
